iti28:1.1: dve dhamme anukkaṭi. [Dukanipāto.] (Duk. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti28:2.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭhe-va dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ sa-upāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ, kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā. Katamehi dvīhi? Indriyesu aguttadvāratāya ca bhojane amattaññutāya ca. Imehi bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhaṃ viharati savighātaṃ sa-upāyāsaṃ sapariḷāhaṃ, kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā duggati pāṭikaṅkhā ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti28:3.1: Cakkhu sotañca ghānañca jivhā kāyo tathā mano | etāni yassa dvārāni aguttāni-dha bhikkhuno ||
iti28:4.1: bhojanamhi amattaññū indriyesu asaṃvuto | kāyadukkhaṃ cetodukkhaṃ dukkhaṃ so adhigacchati ||
iti28:5.1: Ḍayhamānena kāyena ḍayhamānena cetasā | divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ dukkhaṃ viharati tādiso ti ||
iti28:6.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||1||
